asr_text: Stonewatchers were more likely to make another person's rewards smaller. In one test, this was true only for people who strongly liked seeing others suffer. In another, it was true at every level. The tests suggest choices may matter along with personality, but they do not show that offering a choice to make rewards bigger stops meanness or applies to everyday life.
